recommendation_STATEMENT: SpaceX Falcon Payload User's Guide (2025-05-09 and 2021-09 editions): primary lateral > 10 Hz, primary axial > 25 Hz, secondary structure > 35 Hz (a recommendation; payloads below it 'can be accommodated' with mission-specific loads). Written for payloads of ~1.8-9 t (Rev 2 text); a 98 t stack is far outside that range. The Starship Payload User's Guide v1 gives load factors only and states no frequency requirement (so applying 10/25 Hz to Starship is an ASSUMPTION).
label: ESTIMATE: posts-only axial spring chain, rigid base and bodies (upper-bound frequency); lateral = post-group bending plus an undesigned shear path; not a coupled-loads analysis
